name: dsh-prompt-forge
description: On by default: replies must not invent facts, must say where claims came from, and check themselves before delivering. A star left of the input box turns your draft into a clearer prompt — cancellable mid-run, one click restores your words. A number beside it shows roughly what this chat costs; click for the breakdown. It learns from its mistakes, switching only when a new approach beats the old on a fixed test.
